# GarageFarm.NET

> > Cloud render farm service supporting Blender, 3ds Max, Maya, Cinema 4D, Houdini, and Modo for professional 3D artists and studios worldwide.

GarageFarm.NET provides scalable cloud rendering infrastructure with renderBeamer technology for animation studios, architectural visualization firms, and independent 3D artists. The service supports major DCC applications from Autodesk, Maxon, and Foundry, with specialized workflows for character animation, architectural visualization, and Japanese anime production.

## Key Topics

- Cloud rendering services
- Blender render farm
- 3ds Max rendering
- Maya character animation
- Cinema 4D rendering
- Houdini simulation rendering
- Modo renderer support
- renderBeamer technology
- Architectural visualization
- Anime production workflows
- 3D modeling optimization
- GPU and CPU rendering
- Scene optimization techniques
- Render farm comparison (in-house vs cloud)
- ZBrush workflow integration

- [レンダーファームの在り方：社内ファームとオンラインファーム](https://garagefarm.net/jp-blog/the-render-farm-landscape-in-house-versus-online): Comparison of in-house vs online render farms for CG production studios
- [レンダーファームがコンピュータの寿命を延ばすために役立つ理由](https://garagefarm.net/jp-blog/online-render-farm-services-and-your-computers-longevity): How render farms extend PC longevity by reducing hardware stress
